supersedes.schema: Nothing: purely additive (no constraint, function, index or policy redefined). Existing lists and items are not modified.
client: src/lib/supabase/shopping-lists.ts saveShoppingListToSupabase: one INSERT of a whole list and all its items on every generation and every click on an item (replaced by save_shopping_list once per week content and set_shopping_items_checked per item).
Shopping page reading this device's cache before the account list (now the account list of that week first; the cache only when the account cannot be reached).
List freshness by generated_at < weeks.updated_at, which since B4 also moves when the same menu is applied again (now the canonical week signature; the old rule only for lists without one).
Shopping generation aborted when leaving the page and started again on return (now one generation per week content, shared by every caller).
supersedes.rollout: The previous client keeps working with this migration applied, and the new client reuses its lists (scripts/shopping-db-tests.cjs, scenario 8).

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX shopping_lists_week_id_created_at_idx ON public.shopping_lists USING btree (week_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
